strings.name: Andrea Orcel
strings.summary: Orcel moved from fixed income and financial-institution deal advice into international bank management, with senior Merrill Lynch and UBS roles before becoming UniCredit CEO in 2021. Cost efficiency, capital allocation and cross-border expansion shape his agenda. Commerzbank stakes and a withdrawn Santander job offer illustrate the regulatory, political and governance complexity of European banking.
